# Welcome to My Portfolio

Hi I'm Ben - a data scientist with a background in industrial statistics and food science. I have a few projects featured here, my blog contains more projects and thoughts. Check back soon for more updates.

- [Manufacturing Control Charts](https://benjepson.github.io/Manufacturing-SPC-comparison) This is a foundational demonstration of using a control chart, inspired by real manufacturing scenarios. I demonstrate how control charts are a powerful way to look at data.

- [Wine quality](https://benjepson.github.io/wine-quality) Here I use the well known wine quality dataset to show some fundamental exploratory data analysis, visualization, and predictive modeling. I focus on my thought process throughout. This project uses linear regression and random forest models to predict wine quality, and I conclude with some thoughts and next steps.

- Blog: [My thoughts and more projects](https://benjepson.github.io/blog) I will be adding smaller projects here, capturing my thought process.
